comparison_title: Naive REST Baseline vs High-Concurrency Redis Lua Engine

physical_limits: Single NIC loopback interface contention (client and server competing for local CPU cache & sockets)
OS Ephemeral port exhaustion (cannot sustain 50,000 true distinct TCP client sockets simultaneously on single IP)
Single machine memory bandwidth and core throttling under dual client-server loads
what_was_proven_locally: Absolute invariant correctness (0 oversell, 0 monotonicity violations under 1,000 parallel workers)
Sub-millisecond Redis Lua execution vs fatal race conditions in read-then-write pattern
Idempotency and connection stability under concurrent bursts

production_capacity_extrapolation.architecture: 3x Gateway Nodes (4 vCPU, 8GB RAM each) behind AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB) + Redis ElastiCache MemoryDB cluster (m6g.xlarge) + Aurora PostgreSQL
